pictures.name: lyre_on_the_step
pictures.scene: a small wooden lyre resting on a broad sunlit stone step, its frame and strings lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the wall and the open court above it quiet and pale and free of detail

pictures.name: low_step_before_the_gate
pictures.scene: one worn stone step at the foot of a tall closed gate of cedar and bronze, the tread lit warm and low from one side, the great height of the gate above it dark and plain and holding no ornament

pictures.name: steady_flame_in_the_wind
pictures.scene: one small lamp flame burning upright and unmoved on a windy ledge with the grass beside it bent flat, the flame and the ledge lit warm and gold low in the frame, the sky above it grey and racing

pictures.name: sunlight_breaking_into_a_ravine
pictures.scene: a narrow rock ravine with one broad shaft of sun reaching all the way down to its floor, the lit stone glowing warm at the bottom of the frame, the walls rising away above it dark and close and sheer

pictures.name: crowns_set_down_on_the_step
pictures.scene: several plain gold circlets laid down together on a broad stone step, their rims catching one warm low light at the bottom of the frame, the wide court above and behind them dim and swept and empty

pictures.name: long_track_through_the_hills
pictures.scene: a single track winding away through open rolling hills in late light, its nearest stones lit warm and gold, the long fall and rise of the country above it going soft and blue toward the far horizon

pictures.name: small_flower_in_the_rock
pictures.scene: one small bright flower rooted in a crack of enormous grey rock, the bloom lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the vast smooth face of the stone above it plain and dim and unbroken

pictures.name: narrow_gorge_with_light_ahead
pictures.scene: a narrow gorge of dark rock with a bright warm opening showing at its far end, the near walls lit faintly along the bottom of the frame, the cliffs above closing in deep and quiet and without detail

pictures.name: rope_lowered_into_the_pit
pictures.scene: a strong knotted rope hanging down into a deep stone pit from the daylight above, the lit strands warm and clear low in the frame, the walls around and above them wet and dark and entirely bare

pictures.name: finished_bowl_on_the_wheel
pictures.scene: one smooth clay bowl standing finished and still on a stone wheel, its rim lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the quiet workroom above and behind it brown and dim and completely at rest

lines.text: Of David.
I give You thanks with all my heart;
before the gods I sing Your praises.
I bow down toward Your holy temple
and give thanks to Your name
for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness;
You have exalted Your name
and Your word above all else.
On the day I called, You answered me;
You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD,
when they hear the words of Your mouth.
They will sing of the ways of the LORD,
for the glory of the LORD is great.
Though the LORD is on high,
He attends to the lowly;
but the proud He knows from afar.
If I walk in the midst of trouble,
You preserve me from the anger of my foes;
You extend Your hand,
and Your right hand saves me.
The LORD will fulfill
His purpose for me.
O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever—
do not abandon the works of Your hands.
